sections.title: Executive summary
sections.hint: In one or two paragraphs: the business problem, the proposed solution, and the expected outcome.

sections.title: Background and problem
sections.hint: How things work today, what goes wrong, who is affected, and what it costs.

sections.title: Business objectives
sections.hint: Measurable goals the project must achieve, as a bulleted list.

sections.title: In scope
sections.hint: What this project delivers, as a bulleted list. Use the project's top-level items.

sections.title: Out of scope
sections.hint: What this project explicitly does not deliver.

sections.title: Stakeholders
sections.hint: A table of stakeholders: name or role, interest, and responsibility.

sections.title: Business requirements
sections.hint: Lead-in: how requirements are organised (one subsection per top-level item).

sections.title: Requirement
sections.hint: What the business needs from this part of the system, why, and how success is recognised. Numbered list of requirements.

sections.title: Assumptions and constraints
sections.hint: Assumptions that, if wrong, change the plan; constraints such as budget, deadlines, regulations, technology.

sections.title: Success metrics
sections.hint: How the objectives will be measured after go-live, with target values.

sections.title: Milestones
sections.hint: Key dates (from releases and plans if known) as a table: milestone, date, notes.

sections.title: Approval
sections.hint: Who must approve this document; leave space for names, roles, and dates.
